title: Round 19: stat, trinket and small icons

cards.title: Stat icons in style A
cards.text: Every stat icon is now style A, painted, no tile. On by default. Style B is a switch in Settings.
cards.why: You picked A for stats beside a number ("Maybe B"), so A is in and B is built too. Mark any icon that doesn't read.
cards.details:
35 icons: every stat the game shows (health, armour, speed, damage, hits a second, reach, cooldown, ability haste, healing, potency, kills, runs, taken, blocked, downs, revives, best hit, XP, gold, found in, elite, major, level, fills at, fades, time, in the bag, floor). Also the skill web's nodes, and two spares (regen, critical) that nothing uses yet.

One rule throughout: speed lines mean faster. That's the sword for hits a second, the boot for move speed, and the clock for ability haste. Cooldown is a clock with the game's own cooldown wipe on it.

The skill web's stat nodes use the same icons now, greyed until you can learn them, like the ability nodes. An ability's own power, cooldown, mending and potency nodes have a small spark on them.

Settings has a new Stat icons row: Painted (A), Bold glyph (B), or Stand-in (the old set). ?icons=b also works in a browser.

cards.title: Trinkets, tried again
cards.text: All 30 trinkets with no container, just the object. Two ways to paint them. Tick what works.
cards.why: You didn't like the trinkets' containers. Both sets live in Settings → Trinket, potion and small icons; until you pick one, the game keeps today's drawings.

items.label: 1 · Painted object
items.text: Style A's painted object with no medallion: the sprite ink outline, one shade step, a highlight. Big, then on the trader's shelf, at 18 and 28 px, and dropped on a dungeon floor.

items.label: 2 · Soft paint
items.text: Lighter. No ink: the edge is a thin pale rim in a tint of the object's own colours, and it casts a soft shadow. The same drawings as 1.

cards.title: Potions and small icons
cards.text: The 6 potions and the stand-in UI pictures, painted the same way, no container. They switch with the trinkets.
cards.why: Mark any that don't read. Each potion keeps its own bottle shape and colour, with its mark in the liquid.
cards.details:
Potions: Healing Draught (round, a cross), Quicksilver Tonic (tall, a bolt and speed lines), Clockwork Elixir (wide, a clock), Salamander Oil (square, a crossed-out flame), Iron Skin Brew (square, a shield), Troll Draught (a cone flask, a leaf).

UI pictures that change with the switch: the gold coin (it was a CSS circle), the skill-point gem, and the glyphs that stand for a thing: lock, potions button, the fire seat, resting moon, trait crown, checkpoint flag, the leave and new-dungeon door, the trader's bag, the weapon sword, skull. Controls (back, plus, check, pause, play, settings, the tab bar) stay as line icons.

Also drawn but not in the game yet: a key, a chest and a book. The camp's buttons (Book, Battle, Trader, Settings, Wagon) are scene art, not stand-ins, so they stay as they are.

The Settings row for this is in the last picture.
